scoring_justification: T0 result-level compare against paper-derived reference barrier values. Recomputation from raw DFT outputs is infeasible in the checker environment, so compare agent-reported barriers to reference values with generous tolerances that account for DFT code/functional differences.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference energy barrier values for each required strain.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from Figure 1a of the paper, which presents the computed DFT energy barrier vs. uniform in-plane strain for monolayer α-In₂Se₃.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted approximate values from the paper's figure, then validated against the reference Quantum ESPRESSO/SSSP calculation that forms the oracle.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values represent the quantitative trend reported in the paper, not arbitrary numbers, and are used as a comparison baseline with generous tolerances.

outputs.description: Energy barrier for out-of-plane polarization switching in monolayer α-In₂Se₃ under uniform in-plane strain.
